sentences.text: A CROW perishing with thirst saw a pitcher, and hoping to find water, flew to it with delight.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误
sentences.readingHintZh: 主语 A CROW 后的 perishing with thirst 修饰乌鸦，表示“渴得快要死了”。saw 与 flew 是 and 连接的两个谓语；hoping to find water 说明飞过去时的愿望，with delight 表示高兴的状态。

sentences.text: When he reached it, he discovered to his grief that it contained so little water that he could not possibly get at it.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误

relativeClauses.text: that he could not possibly get at it

subordinateClauses.text: that it contained so little water that he could not possibly get at it

sentences.readingHintZh: When he reached it 是时间状语从句；主句为 he discovered ...。discovered 后第一个 that 引出宾语从句；其中 so little water that ... 是“水少到……”的程度—结果结构，第二个 that 从句不是修饰 water 的定语从句。to his grief 表示令他难过的是。

sentences.text: He tried everything he could think of to reach the water, but all his efforts were in vain.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误
sentences.readingHintZh: 先找主语候选“He”，再看句法中心“tried”。再读与中心词连接的宾语或补语候选“everything he could think of”，确认动作对象或说明内容。留意连接标记“but”；回到原句判断它连接的是词语、短语还是分句。解析器标出的定语从句候选是“he could think of”；先读被修饰的名词，再回看这部分补充说明。从句或非谓语补充部分候选为“to reach the water”；先读主句，再核对各部分与中心词的关系。

sentences.text: At last he collected as many stones as he could carry and dropped them one by one with his beak into the pitcher, until he brought the water within his reach and thus saved his life.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误

subordinateClauses.text: as he could carry and dropped them one by one with his beak into the pitcher, until he brought the water within his reach and thus saved his life
until he brought the water within his reach and thus saved his life

sentences.readingHintZh: 主句中 he collected ... and dropped ... 是并列谓语。as many stones as he could carry 表示“他能带来的那么多石子”，比较从句到 carry 结束，不包含 dropped。until 引出后续结果达到的时间界限；brought 与 saved 在该从句中并列。

sentences.text: Necessity is the mother of invention.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误
sentences.readingHintZh: 先找主语候选“Necessity”，再看句法中心“is”。再读与中心词连接的宾语或补语候选“the mother of invention”，确认动作对象或说明内容。

existingAnnotation.text: Necessity is the mother of invention.
existingAnnotation.analysis: Necessity 是抽象名词作主语，is 是系动词，the mother of invention 是表语。这是比喻：迫切的需要会促使人想出新办法。
